hero.heading: Our Classes
hero.intro: Four ways to move. One space to grow.

items.name: Foundations Reformer
items.seoTitle: Foundations Reformer Class | Beginner Pilates Limassol | KLUB
items.seoDescription: Never tried reformer Pilates? Foundations Reformer at KLUB Limassol teaches you the machine from zero. 50 minutes, small group, taught in English. First class €20.
intro: If you have never stepped onto a reformer — or it has been a while — this is where you start. Fundamentals is a slow, deliberate introduction to the machine: the carriage, the springs, the straps, and how your body works with each of them.

Your instructor walks the room the whole time. With six people maximum, nobody gets lost in the back row. You will leave knowing the foundational movements that every other class builds on — and why your core feels like it just woke up.
expect: A full tour of the reformer before you move
Foundational exercises: footwork, bridging, arm work, basic core series
Constant hands-on guidance and modifications for your body
A calm pace — strength over speed
goodFor: Anyone returning to movement after a break or injury
Experienced movers who want to refine their technique
items.imageAlt: Two women training together with a medicine ball in warm studio light

items.name: Signature Reformer
items.seoTitle: Signature Reformer Class | Dynamic Pilates Limassol | KLUB
items.seoDescription: Signature Reformer at KLUB Limassol: 50 minutes of dynamic, breath-led reformer sequences for intermediate and advanced movers. Small groups, taught in English.
intro: The Signature is the class KLUB is built around. Movements link into continuous, breath-led sequences — one exercise melting into the next — with the pace, resistance and layered progressions that reward movers who already know the reformer.
Rooted in classical technique and shaped by our instructors’ dance training, it builds stamina, coordination and control week over week: the choreography becomes familiar, and then it becomes yours.
expect: Continuous sequences with minimal stops
Progressions layered through the class — take the challenge or keep the base
Full-body work: legs, core, arms, back
A proper burn, and a proper cool-down
goodFor: Those who love rhythm and momentum in a workout
Building lean, functional strength week over week
items.imageAlt: Instructor in a foot-strap stretch on a reformer, coaching her form

items.name: Mat Pilates
items.seoTitle: Mat Pilates Class | Core Strength & Mobility Limassol | KLUB
items.seoDescription: Mat Pilates at KLUB Limassol: 50 minutes of classical mat work for deep core strength, mobility and control. All levels welcome, small groups, taught in English.
intro: Mat Pilates is where the method began — just you, the mat, and gravity. No springs to help and none to hide behind, which is exactly why mat work builds such honest, deep core strength.

Expect classical sequences taught with precision: articulation through the spine, control in every transition, and options at every level. It sharpens everything you do on the reformer — and stands alone as a complete practice.
expect: Classical mat sequences, taught step by step
Deep core, spine mobility and posture work
Small props (bands, balls, rings) to challenge or support
Options for every level, every round
goodFor: Building a strong, honest core foundation
items.imageAlt: Woman holding a long plank position on a mat against a warm plaster wall

items.name: Private Sessions
items.seoTitle: Private Pilates Sessions | 1-to-1 Training Limassol | KLUB
items.seoDescription: Private 1-to-1 reformer Pilates in Limassol city center. Personalized sessions for injury recovery, pre/post-natal training and athletic goals. From €80 per session.
intro: One reformer, one instructor, one plan built entirely around you. Private sessions are the fastest way to progress — every minute of the 50 is calibrated to your body, your history and your goals.

They are also the right choice when a group setting is not: recovering from injury, training through or after pregnancy, or simply preferring privacy and a schedule that bends to yours. Our instructors are certified in pre- and post-natal movement, so you are in qualified hands at every stage.
expect: A movement assessment in your first session
A program designed for your specific goals
Pre/post-natal certified instruction when you need it
Flexible scheduling by appointment
items.imageAlt: Instructor guiding a client one-to-one on a reformer

Monthly packs (4, 8 or 12 classes) are valid for one month. Flexi packs (10 or 20 classes) are valid for three months from purchase. Credits are not extendable and unused classes don't roll over.

space.heading: The Space

On the floor: professional reformer machines, capped at six per class, arranged so every person has space to move and be seen by their instructor.

hero.heading: Your Questions, Answered
hero.intro: Everything people ask before their first class — and a few things they wish they'd asked.

still.heading: Still have questions?
still.text: Message us — we typically reply within 30 minutes during business hours.

items.q: What is reformer Pilates?
items.a: Reformer Pilates is practiced on a machine with a sliding carriage, springs and straps. The springs add resistance and support, making exercises both harder and safer than mat work alone. It builds strength, flexibility and control — and it is genuinely fun.

items.q: Do I need any experience to start?
items.a: None at all. Our Foundations Reformer class is built for complete beginners — you will learn the machine from zero with a maximum of six people in the room.

items.q: What should I wear?
items.a: Comfortable leggings or shorts and a fitted top that lets your instructor see your alignment. Avoid anything with zips that could scratch the equipment.

items.q: Do I need grip socks?
items.a: Yes — grip socks are required in all classes for hygiene and safety. Bring your own or buy a pair at reception (€12).

items.q: What should I bring?
items.a: Just yourself, grip socks and a bottle of water. Everything else is provided.

items.q: What happens if I arrive late?
items.a: Doors close 10 minutes after class starts — the warm-up matters for safety. If you miss the window, we will happily help you rebook.

items.q: Is Pilates a good workout, or is it too gentle?
items.a: Both, depending on the class. Foundations is measured and controlled; the Signature Reformer will challenge experienced athletes. Every class is a genuine full-body workout — expect to feel muscles you forgot you had.

items.q: How quickly will I notice results?
items.a: Most people feel a difference in posture and core awareness within a few sessions, and see visible change with two to three classes a week over a couple of months. Consistency beats intensity.

items.q: How big are the classes?
items.a: Maximum six people. Small enough that your instructor sees and corrects every rep.

items.q: How long is a class?
items.a: All group classes and private sessions are 50 minutes.

items.q: Can I book a private 1-to-1 session?
items.a: Yes — we are one of the few city-center studios offering true private sessions. They run by appointment and start from €80 per session in packs.

items.q: How do I book?
items.a: Online booking opens shortly before we launch in September 2026. Until then, join the founding member list for first access, or message us and we will reserve your spot personally.

items.q: What's the cancellation policy?
items.a: Cancel at least 12 hours before class and your credit returns to your account automatically. Later than that, the class is charged — the spot was held for you in a room of six.

items.q: Is there a waitlist for full classes?
items.a: Yes. If a class is full, join the waitlist and you will be notified automatically the moment a spot opens.

items.q: Where exactly is the studio?
items.a: We are in Limassol city center. The exact street address is being announced with our opening — join the founding member list or follow @klubstudios and you will be the first to know.

items.q: Is there parking nearby?
items.a: Yes — public parking is available within a short walk of the studio. We will publish a simple parking guide before opening day.

items.q: Can I reach you by public transport?
items.a: The studio is centrally located and well served by city bus routes. Exact stop details will be published with our address.

items.q: Do you have changing rooms?
items.a: Yes — changing facilities are available, so a lunchtime class between meetings is absolutely doable.

items.q: Can I store my things during class?
items.a: Yes, there is space for your belongings inside the studio, always within sight.

items.q: Is the studio air-conditioned?
items.a: Yes — comfortably cool in summer and warm in winter. Cyprus summers are no joke; we have planned for them.

items.q: Can I do Pilates while pregnant?
items.a: In many cases yes, with the right guidance. Our instructors are fully certified in pre-natal movement. We recommend private sessions during pregnancy so everything is tailored to you — and always check with your doctor first.

items.q: When can I return after giving birth?
items.a: Every recovery is different. With your doctor's clearance — typically from six weeks after birth — our post-natal certified instructors will rebuild your strength gradually and safely, starting with the deep core.

items.q: I have back pain. Is reformer Pilates safe for me?
items.a: Reformer Pilates is often recommended for back pain because the springs support you while you strengthen the muscles that protect your spine. Tell us about your pain when you book — we may suggest starting with a private session.

items.q: Can I train with an injury?
items.a: Often yes, and thoughtfully. Message us about your injury before booking. Private sessions let us work around and with your body; in group classes we offer modifications for most exercises.

items.q: Do you offer modifications in class?
items.a: Constantly. With six people maximum, your instructor adapts exercises to your level and any limitations in real time.

items.q: Is reformer Pilates safe for older adults?
items.a: Yes — the reformer is one of the most joint-friendly ways to build strength and balance at any age. Foundations Reformer is the right starting point.

items.q: Should I eat before class?
items.a: Keep it light. A small snack an hour or two before is ideal; a full meal right before class is not your friend on the reformer.

items.q: Do I need to tell you about health conditions?
items.a: Please do — it stays confidential and it helps us keep you safe. There is space for this when you register, and you can always message us privately.

items.q: How much does a class cost?
items.a: A single intro class is €20 and a drop-in is €32. Packs bring the per-class price down to as low as €18, and monthly packs start at €96 for four classes. The intro offer is three classes for €55. Full details are on our pricing page.

items.q: Do class packs expire?
items.a: Flexi packs (10 or 20 classes) are valid for three months. Monthly packs (4, 8 or 12 classes) are valid for one month.

items.q: Can I share my pack with someone else?
items.a: Packs are personal. Friends are always welcome to join you with their own drop-in or intro pack.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Card and cash at the studio, and card online once booking opens.

items.q: Is there a refund policy?
items.a: Unused, unexpired packs can be discussed case by case — talk to us. Completed classes and expired packs are non-refundable.

items.q: Are there founding member rates?
items.a: Yes — joining the founding member list before we open locks in exclusive rates and first access to bookings.

items.q: What language are classes taught in?
items.a: All classes are taught in English, and we welcome every nationality. Our team also speaks Greek.

items.q: Do I need to speak Greek to join?
items.a: Not at all. English is the language of the studio, and much of our community is international.

items.q: Can I come alone?
items.a: Most people do. Classes of six get friendly fast — coming alone is the normal way to arrive and rarely how people leave.

items.q: Is the studio beginner-friendly in atmosphere?
items.a: Completely. No mirrored walls of intimidation, no competitive energy. Chill vibes are found here — it is on the wall, and we mean it.

hero.heading: Studio Policies
hero.intro: Short, fair and there to keep classes running smoothly for everyone.

sections.title: First Time at KLUB
items: New to the reformer? We recommend starting with Foundations Reformer, and arriving 10 minutes early so we can introduce you to the equipment and answer any questions.
Grip socks are required — you can buy a pair at reception (€12) if you forget yours.

sections.title: Grip Socks
items: Grip socks are required in every class — for hygiene and for safety on the reformer. No socks, no entry.
Forgot yours? Pairs are available at reception for €12.

sections.title: Arrival & Late Policy
items: Please arrive 5–10 minutes early, and 10 minutes early for your very first visit.
For safety, the studio is locked 10 minutes after class starts — late entry may not be permitted once class has begun.
If you miss the cut-off, message us and we'll help you rebook.

sections.title: Cancellation & No-Show
items: Cancel at least 12 hours before class and your credit is returned automatically.
Classes cancelled inside 12 hours, and no-shows, result in a loss of credit — in a class of six, your spot matters.
Credits are not extendable. Genuine emergencies happen — talk to us.

sections.title: Class Pack Expiry
items: Monthly packs (4, 8 or 12 classes) are valid for one month.
Flexi packs (10 or 20 classes) are valid for three months from purchase.
Credits are not extendable and unused classes don't roll over.

sections.title: Health & Safety
items: Tell us about injuries, pregnancy or health conditions before your first class — it stays confidential and helps us keep you safe.
Our instructors are fully certified and insured, including pre/post-natal qualification, and equipment is cleaned between every class.
Classes are attended at your own risk; KLUB cannot be held liable for injuries sustained in the studio.

sections.title: Privacy
items: We collect only the details needed to manage your bookings and keep in touch: name, contact details and any health information you choose to share.
We never sell or share your data with third parties for marketing.
Marketing emails are opt-in and every one includes an unsubscribe link.
To access or delete your data, email team@klub-cy.com — we comply with GDPR.
